title: Sri Lankan passport renewal
steps: Book an appointment on the Department of Immigration & Emigration online portal (or visit Battaramulla/regional office)
Complete form K (application for a new passport)
Gather documents: current passport, NIC, birth certificate, studio photo per ICAO spec
Pay the fee (one-day, urgent or normal service)
Attend in person for biometrics; collect or receive by post
typicalProcessing: Normal ~14 working days; one-day service available at Battaramulla
tip: Many airlines and destinations require 6 months of remaining validity — treat expiry minus 6 months as your real deadline.

title: Passport renewal (general)
steps: Check your national passport authority's current process — most support online application
Prepare a compliant photo and your existing passport
Complete the renewal form and pay the fee
Submit biometrics if required
Track and collect
typicalProcessing: Commonly 2–6 weeks depending on country and season
tip: Six months' remaining validity is a common entry requirement — renew well before the printed expiry.

title: Visa / residence permit renewal (general)
steps: Confirm the exact renewal window for your visa class — many must be filed before the current one expires
Gather the standard evidence pack: passport, current permit, proof of status (study/work), financials, photos
Complete the official application online and pay fees
Book biometrics if required
Keep proof of in-time filing — it often preserves your status while the decision is pending
tip: File before expiry, always — in many countries an in-time application legally extends your stay while it's processed. Verify rules on the official immigration site.

title: Sri Lankan driving licence renewal
steps: Obtain the medical fitness certificate (NTMI or approved center) if required for your age/class
Visit the Department of Motor Traffic (Werahera or district office) or use available online services
Submit the current licence, NIC and medical certificate
Pay the renewal fee
Collect the new licence or receive by post
tip: Book the medical early — it's the step that usually delays people.

title: Driving licence renewal (general)
steps: Check your licensing authority's renewal channel (online is common)
Complete any required vision/medical check
Submit the form with photo and fee
Receive the new licence
tip: Driving on an expired licence can void your insurance — treat the act-by date seriously.

title: Vehicle insurance renewal
steps: Request renewal quotes 3–4 weeks out — loyalty rarely gets the best price
Compare at least two insurers on like-for-like cover
Confirm no-claims discount carries over
Pay and store the new certificate here
Check the policy start date leaves no coverage gap
tip: Even one uninsured day is a legal and financial risk — align the new policy to start the moment the old one ends.

title: Vehicle revenue licence renewal (Sri Lanka)
steps: Ensure the insurance certificate and emission test are current — both are prerequisites
Renew online via the eRL portal or at the Divisional Secretariat
Pay the fee based on vehicle class
Print/keep the licence in the vehicle
typicalProcessing: Minutes online; same day in person
tip: The emission test expiring is what silently blocks most online renewals — check it first.

title: Health insurance renewal
steps: Review this year's usage and whether the cover still fits
Ask the insurer for the renewal terms and any premium change
Compare against one alternative before auto-renewing
Confirm continuity of pre-existing-condition coverage
Pay and file the new policy schedule
tip: Never let it lapse when switching — a gap can reset waiting periods for pre-existing conditions.

title: Warranty expiry check
steps: Before it expires, test the product properly — this is your last free-repair window
If anything is off, file the claim now with the receipt and serial number
Check whether an extended warranty is worth it for this item
After expiry, keep the receipt anyway — consumer law sometimes protects beyond warranty
tip: The two weeks before a warranty ends are the cheapest repair window you'll ever have — use them.

title: Domain name renewal
steps: Turn on auto-renew and verify the payment card on file is current
Confirm the registrant email is one you still control
Renew multi-year for domains that matter
Check WHOIS shows the new expiry after paying
tip: Expired domains get snapped up by squatters within hours — this is the one renewal to automate completely.

title: Professional certification renewal
steps: Check the renewal requirements: exam, CPE/CE credits, or fee-only
Log any outstanding credits/training now — they take time to earn
Complete the renewal application before the deadline
Save the new certificate and update your CV/LinkedIn
tip: Credit-based renewals fail from procrastinated coursework, not the form — start the learning at the act-by date.

title: Prescription / medication renewal
steps: Count remaining doses a week ahead
Request the repeat from your clinic/pharmacy
Book a review appointment if the prescriber requires one
Collect before you run out
tip: Weekends and holidays are when people run out — the 7-day buffer exists for them.

title: Subscription renewal decision
steps: Decide: still worth it? This is the moment to cancel without losing paid time
Check for a cheaper annual tier or a retention offer
If keeping, verify the payment method; if not, cancel and note the end date
tip: Set the act-by reminder as your 'do I still use this?' ritual — it pays for the app many times over.
